Method of Attack: Reverse TCP shell for Linux offering basic command and control (C2) capabilities
Used as a persistent backdoor via 'NoHup' command to prevent termination
Data exfiltration directly to C2 server using TCP or HTTP connections
Impacted Systems: Linux systems with compromised cPanel accounts
Attack Vector: Compromised cPanel accounts accessed via SSH
Indicators of Compromise: Installation of Adminer database management tool in public directory of compromised cPanel accounts
Copies of email archives placed in public web directory for downloading
Use of VPN tools by threat actors connecting to compromised cPanel accounts
Overwriting Linux system log files and unsetting Bash and MySQL history files
